###### Helping States Solve Environmental Challenges

Air Quality • Clean Transportation • Digital and Information Solutions • Permitting, Compliance, and
Enforcement • Wastewater and Infrastructure

][47]

For more than 40 years, ERG has been at the forefront of helping state agencies and organizations in
addressing pressing environmental challenges and enhancing their programs to protect the environment
and communities. ERG provides our clients tailored, impactful support to meet their unique needs. We
identify and bring together an array of skills from across ERG, utilizing a cross-disciplinary team
of environmental scientists, engineers, communications specialists, data scientists, economists, web
designers, and other professionals to develop innovative solutions in collaboration with our
clients.

We support organizations at multiple levels—state, regional, county, tribal, and local—to solve
environmental challenges in states across the country.

Here are examples of how our team delivers impactful support across the country:

**Making Post-Wildfire Environmental Monitoring Data Accessible to All - **In response to the tragic
Maui wildfires in 2023, ERG has been supporting the Hawaii Department of Health and partners in
compiling, visualizing, and providing public access to environmental sampling data for a range of
hazardous substances that could have been released during the fires in Lahaina and Kula in an
interactive [online data dashboard][48]. This initiative ensures that the public has access to
crucial information, empowering individuals, families, and communities to make informed decisions
and take necessary precautions to protect their health and safety.

**Improving Air Quality and Optimizing Permitting Efficiency -** ERG’s team of air quality and
permitting experts helps our regulatory clients more efficiently and thoroughly review permits,
while ensuring compliance with air quality regulations. For Maricopa County, Arizona, ERG is helping
the county maintain an exceptional record of meeting required air quality permitting timelines
through the implementation of efficient but rigorous permit review procedures. Similarly, ERG staff
has been approved as a Qualified Professional under Pennsylvania’s Streamlining Permits for Economic
Expansion and Development (SPEED) program, helping the state in expediting air permit reviews while
keeping economic development considerations at the forefront.

**Assessing Air Quality Impacts from Industry -** For Colorado, ERG is evaluating the air quality
impacts of petroleum refineries in the state, comparing relevant regulatory requirements in the
state with requirements in other states and Federal regulations, and identifying best practices and
technologies to help state regulators minimize emissions from petroleum refineries.

**Helping Eliminate Lead in Drinking Water -** For multiple states, such as Hawaii, New Mexico, and
Nevada, ERG has helped develop lead service line inventories to reduce community exposure to lead in
drinking water and comply with the federal Lead and Copper Rule Revisions (LCRR).

**Protecting Wetlands -** For the Colorado Department of Public Health and Environment, ERG helped
implement an interim dredge and fill program by establishing permitting processes to protect the
water quality and biodiversity in sensitive wetland habitats for “gap waters” that fall outside the
federal Clean Water Act’s jurisdiction.

**Reducing Surface Water Pollution -** ERG provides wide-ranging technical support across multiple
states including Arizona, Hawaii, Idaho, Nevada, Montana, New Mexico, Oregon, and Virginia, to
protect surface water quality through implementation of the National Pollutant Discharge Elimination
System (NPDES). This includes supporting water quality standards and total maximum daily load (TMDL)
programs, developing nutrient trading approaches, writing NPDES permits, conducting compliance
inspections, supporting enforcement, providing training, and more.

**Creating Healthy and Sustainable Learning Environments for Children -** ERG’s sustainability
experts and public health scientists have prepared a comprehensive report for the Massachusetts
State Legislature, identifying strategies and best practices for creating sustainable and healthy
learning environments for students across the Commonwealth. ERG’s clean transportation experts have
provided technical and planning support to many states to guide their school bus electrification
efforts. For New York, ERG developed a School Bus Electrification Roadmap and Guidebook, and ERG
assists the Massachusetts Clean Energy Center and eight Massachusetts school districts in achieving
the school bus electrification goals set by the state. Under contract to the U.S. EPA, ERG’s

###### Helping States Solve Environmental Challenges

Air Quality • Clean Transportation • Digital and Information Solutions • Permitting, Compliance, and

][47]

For more than 40 years, ERG has been at the forefront of helping state agencies and organizations in
addressing pressing environmental challenges and enhancing their programs to protect the environment
and communities. ERG provides our clients tailored, impactful support to meet their unique needs. We
identify and bring together an array of skills from across ERG, utilizing a cross-disciplinary team
of environmental scientists, engineers, communications specialists, data scientists, economists, web
designers, and other professionals to develop innovative solutions in collaboration with our
clients.

We support organizations at multiple levels—state, regional, county, tribal, and local—to solve
environmental challenges in states across the country.

Here are examples of how our team delivers impactful support across the country:

**Making Post-Wildfire Environmental Monitoring Data Accessible to All - **In response to the tragic
Maui wildfires in 2023, ERG has been supporting the Hawaii Department of Health and partners in
compiling, visualizing, and providing public access to environmental sampling data for a range of
hazardous substances that could have been released during the fires in Lahaina and Kula in an
interactive [online data dashboard][48]. This initiative ensures that the public has access to
crucial information, empowering individuals, families, and communities to make informed decisions
and take necessary precautions to protect their health and safety.

**Improving Air Quality and Optimizing Permitting Efficiency -** ERG’s team of air quality and
permitting experts helps our regulatory clients more efficiently and thoroughly review permits,
while ensuring compliance with air quality regulations. For Maricopa County, Arizona, ERG is helping
the county maintain an exceptional record of meeting required air quality permitting timelines
through the implementation of efficient but rigorous permit review procedures. Similarly, ERG staff
has been approved as a Qualified Professional under Pennsylvania’s Streamlining Permits for Economic
Expansion and Development (SPEED) program, helping the state in expediting air permit reviews while
keeping economic development considerations at the forefront.

**Assessing Air Quality Impacts from Industry -** For Colorado, ERG is evaluating the air quality
impacts of petroleum refineries in the state, comparing relevant regulatory requirements in the
state with requirements in other states and Federal regulations, and identifying best practices and
technologies to help state regulators minimize emissions from petroleum refineries.

**Helping Eliminate Lead in Drinking Water -** For multiple states, such as Hawaii, New Mexico, and
Nevada, ERG has helped develop lead service line inventories to reduce community exposure to lead in
drinking water and comply with the federal Lead and Copper Rule Revisions (LCRR).

**Protecting Wetlands -** For the Colorado Department of Public Health and Environment, ERG helped
implement an interim dredge and fill program by establishing permitting processes to protect the
water quality and biodiversity in sensitive wetland habitats for “gap waters” that fall outside the
federal Clean Water Act’s jurisdiction.

**Reducing Surface Water Pollution -** ERG provides wide-ranging technical support across multiple
states including Arizona, Hawaii, Idaho, Nevada, Montana, New Mexico, Oregon, and Virginia, to
protect surface water quality through implementation of the National Pollutant Discharge Elimination
System (NPDES). This includes supporting water quality standards and total maximum daily load (TMDL)
programs, developing nutrient trading approaches, writing NPDES permits, conducting compliance
inspections, supporting enforcement, providing training, and more.

experts and public health scientists have prepared a comprehensive report for the Massachusetts
State Legislature, identifying strategies and best practices for creating sustainable and healthy
learning environments for students across the Commonwealth. ERG’s clean transportation experts have

Advancing materials innovation

## Our position on climate change

In our 2024-2026 Climate Action Transition Plan (2024-2026 CATP), we reconfirmed our targets for
reducing our scope 1, 2 and 3 industrial emissions against our restated 2019 baseline, to reduce at
least 15% by the end of 2026 and at least 50% by 2035 and specified a new 25% reduction target by
the end of 2030. We are currently assessing how best to integrate EVR into our climate transition
strategy, recognising that the transition away from steelmaking coal for steel production will be
slower than thermal coal. Refer to the TCFD section of our latest Annual Report and our 2024-2026
CATP for further information.

## Our position on climate change

In our 2024-2026 Climate Action Transition Plan (2024-2026 CATP), we reconfirmed our targets for
reducing our scope 1, 2 and 3 industrial emissions against our restated 2019 baseline, to reduce at
least 15% by the end of 2026 and at least 50% by 2035 and specified a new 25% reduction target by
the end of 2030. We are currently assessing how best to integrate EVR into our climate transition
strategy, recognising that the transition away from steelmaking coal for steel production will be
slower than thermal coal. Refer to the TCFD section of our latest Annual Report and our 2024-2026
CATP for further information.

# Vale - página inicial

## Transforming mining into sustainable development

We are a global company, operating responsibly in every country where we are present. Our
infrastructure seamlessly connects the extraction of high-quality ore to its transportation via
railways and ports, reaching distribution centers efficiently.
[Simple line illustrated icon of a mining cart with a load. The top is yellow and the bottom is
green]

### Mining and Base Metals

Minerals are present in solutions that transform people’s lives for the better, contributing to the
advancement of society.
[ Learn more about mining  ][96]
[Green and yellow lightning icon]

### Renewable energy

All the electricity used in Vale's operations in Brazil comes from renewable sources, such as
hydroelectric, wind and solar power plants.
[ Learn more about energy  ][97]
[Icon of two green and yellow arrows forming a circle.]

### Integrated logistics

We have developed a logistics network - with mines, railways, ships, and ports - ensuring agility
and efficiency throughout the transportation process.
[ Learn more about logistics ][98]
[
Learn more about what we do
][99]

## Commitment to shared progress

We transform natural resources into sustainable development, always prioritizing people's safety and
environmental preservation.
We work in partnership with communities, governments, and organizations to promote access to
education, culture, healthcare, and social inclusion in the regions where we operate.
[
Learn more about our commitments
][100]
[Four Vale professionals in white helmets and vests reviewing a document inside a mine tunnel]
Photo: Jeferson Capela
[Two scarlet macaws photographed in close-up with a dense and dark Amazon rainforest behind] [Two
scarlet macaws photographed in close-up with a dense and dark Amazon rainforest behind]

Photo: Ricardo Teles

## ESG in practice

### We operate with environmental, social, and governance responsibility.

We are committed to minimizing environmental impacts, empowering local communities, and ensuring
ethical and transparent practices across all our operations. Our goal is to leave a positive and
lasting legacy for society and the regions where we are present.
[
Visit our ESG portal
][101]

## Brumadinho: our commitment to reparation and safety

We have learned from our history and remain committed to the full reparation of individuals and
communities affected by the B1 dam breach.
Our actions are guided by the legal settlement and encompass social, environmental, and safety
initiatives.
[
Check out our reparation efforts
][102]
[Three Vale professionals outdoors: one points to the sky while another holds a site map]
Photo: Nilmar Lage

## How Vale is transforming its operation

[Group of young dancers in colorful full skirts performing a large Brazilian folk dance show]
Photo: Emanuelle Rebelo

### Culture

For over 20 years, we have supported the promotion of Brazilian culture in its many forms. We
believe that access to culture enhances knowledge, strengthens identities, and opens new
perspectives for the future.
[

Learn more about our Culture initiatives

][103]
[Researcher in blue shirt closely examining green plant leaves inside an agricultural greenhouse]
Photo: Emanuelle Rebelo

### Sustainability

Sustainability is one of the key drivers of our business. Together, we think, discuss, design, and
build a future for mining and for the planet—while remaining committed to the present.
[

Learn more about our Sustainability initiatives

][104]
[Smiling woman seated in front of multiple monitors displaying satellite and city images]
Photo: Germano Assunção

### Innovation

We employ robots, drones, and autonomous vehicles to make our operations safer and more efficient.
We also invest in electrification, scientific research, and technological solutions to reduce our
environmental impact and transform mining.
[

Learn more about our Innovation initiatives

][105]
[Two Vale employees with white helmets and ear protection smiling at the mining facility] [Two Vale
employees with white helmets and ear protection smiling at the mining facility]

Photo: Jeferson Capela

## Our people

People are at the heart of our decisions. We value individual talent and strive to be an
increasingly inclusive company—one that acts with respect and fosters open dialogue.
[
Join our team
][106]

## Vale now

# Vale - página inicial

## Transforming mining into sustainable development

We are a global company, operating responsibly in every country where we are present. Our
infrastructure seamlessly connects the extraction of high-quality ore to its transportation via
railways and ports, reaching distribution centers efficiently.
[Simple line illustrated icon of a mining cart with a load. The top is yellow and the bottom is
green]

### Mining and Base Metals

Minerals are present in solutions that transform people’s lives for the better, contributing to the
advancement of society.
[ Learn more about mining  ][96]
[Green and yellow lightning icon]

### Renewable energy

All the electricity used in Vale's operations in Brazil comes from renewable sources, such as
hydroelectric, wind and solar power plants.
[ Learn more about energy  ][97]
[Icon of two green and yellow arrows forming a circle.]

### Integrated logistics

We have developed a logistics network - with mines, railways, ships, and ports - ensuring agility
and efficiency throughout the transportation process.
[ Learn more about logistics ][98]
[
Learn more about what we do
][99]

## Commitment to shared progress

We transform natural resources into sustainable development, always prioritizing people's safety and
environmental preservation.
We work in partnership with communities, governments, and organizations to promote access to
education, culture, healthcare, and social inclusion in the regions where we operate.
[
Learn more about our commitments
][100]
[Four Vale professionals in white helmets and vests reviewing a document inside a mine tunnel]
Photo: Jeferson Capela
[Two scarlet macaws photographed in close-up with a dense and dark Amazon rainforest behind] [Two
scarlet macaws photographed in close-up with a dense and dark Amazon rainforest behind]

Photo: Ricardo Teles

## ESG in practice

### We operate with environmental, social, and governance responsibility.

We are committed to minimizing environmental impacts, empowering local communities, and ensuring
ethical and transparent practices across all our operations. Our goal is to leave a positive and
lasting legacy for society and the regions where we are present.
[
Visit our ESG portal
][101]

## Brumadinho: our commitment to reparation and safety

We have learned from our history and remain committed to the full reparation of individuals and
communities affected by the B1 dam breach.
Our actions are guided by the legal settlement and encompass social, environmental, and safety
initiatives.
[
Check out our reparation efforts
][102]
[Three Vale professionals outdoors: one points to the sky while another holds a site map]
Photo: Nilmar Lage

## How Vale is transforming its operation

[Group of young dancers in colorful full skirts performing a large Brazilian folk dance show]
Photo: Emanuelle Rebelo

### Culture

For over 20 years, we have supported the promotion of Brazilian culture in its many forms. We
believe that access to culture enhances knowledge, strengthens identities, and opens new
perspectives for the future.
[

Learn more about our Culture initiatives

][103]
[Researcher in blue shirt closely examining green plant leaves inside an agricultural greenhouse]
Photo: Emanuelle Rebelo

### Sustainability

Sustainability is one of the key drivers of our business. Together, we think, discuss, design, and
build a future for mining and for the planet—while remaining committed to the present.
[

Learn more about our Sustainability initiatives

][104]
[Smiling woman seated in front of multiple monitors displaying satellite and city images]
Photo: Germano Assunção

### Innovation

We employ robots, drones, and autonomous vehicles to make our operations safer and more efficient.
We also invest in electrification, scientific research, and technological solutions to reduce our
environmental impact and transform mining.
[

Learn more about our Innovation initiatives

][105]
[Two Vale employees with white helmets and ear protection smiling at the mining facility] [Two Vale
employees with white helmets and ear protection smiling at the mining facility]

Photo: Jeferson Capela

## Our people

People are at the heart of our decisions. We value individual talent and strive to be an
increasingly inclusive company—one that acts with respect and fosters open dialogue.
[
Join our team
][106]

## Vale now

We are among the reputed service providers in the industry for handling Vendor Registration in the
company, Business Promoting Services, Marketing Service, Tender Submissions and, Indenting Agent. In
addition, we are also a trader of Ferro Alloys, Silicon Manganese Ore, Calcined Petroleum Coke, and
Dolomite Mineral. Our dedication and honesty towards the work has earned many prestigious clients
from India as well as abroad.

We do the extensive as well as intensive study of the subject before delving into the business to
offer the genuine services to our esteemed clients to overcome the situation and help them stamp
their authority in the domain. We enjoy strong market network and association with prestigious
organizations of integrated steel plants like S.A.I.L, Jindal Steel, NECO and other local steel
industries. Our professionals, having in-depth knowledge and experience that imbibe them to mitigate
the problems such as marketing, indenting, license providing and business promotion as well.
Further, manufacturers who don't want to supply their material directly to SAIL or other industries
due to delay payment or any other reasons we can supply the material on their behalf as a dealer or
traders.

## WELCOME!

Alloys & Metals (India) was envisioned by Late Shreelal Keyal in 1964 and since then it has been
owned by persons exhibiting great calibre in the industry. We are led by Mr. Vijay Keyal, having an
experience of over 40 years, and are being further nurtured by young visionary entrepreneurs Mr.
Ankit Keyal and Mr. Vivek Keyal.

We have been an accredited company with more than two decades of reputation as a trusted partner to
all major customers across the globe.

## OUR PRODUCTS:

We have productively been able to establish ourselves as a renowned name engaged in offering quality
range of Metals and Alloys through our reliable network of suppliers and importers.

## WELCOME!

Alloys & Metals (India) was envisioned by Late Shreelal Keyal in 1964 and since then it has been
owned by persons exhibiting great calibre in the industry. We are led by Mr. Vijay Keyal, having an
experience of over 40 years, and are being further nurtured by young visionary entrepreneurs Mr.
Ankit Keyal and Mr. Vivek Keyal.

We have been an accredited company with more than two decades of reputation as a trusted partner to
all major customers across the globe.

## OUR PRODUCTS:

We have productively been able to establish ourselves as a renowned name engaged in offering quality
range of Metals and Alloys through our reliable network of suppliers and importers.

affection for the industry to execute desired orders, inclusive of hassle-free transactions and

us achieve several awards and recognition from Engineering and Export Promotion Council of India

## Who We Are

Al Tamman Ferroalloys LLC (ATFA) is Sultanate of Oman’s first Ferrochrome Smelter. The production
facilities are strategically located at Free Zone Sohar in proximity to Sohar port.

[Know More][20]
[01]
×

## Vision - Values

To be the most preferred and trusted supplier of Ferroalloys, adding value to Oman’s mineral
resources by harnessing renewable energy—respected locally and recognized globally for our
unwavering commitment to integrity, innovation, and excellence

[Know More][21]
[01]

## International Joint Venture

Muscat Overseas Group is a diversified business group in Oman operating for more than 40 years with
business interest in the areas of Real Estate, Trading, Contracting, Industrial, Oil & Gas, Travel &
Tourism and Mining. In addition, the Group is one of the leading investors in Oman in the listed and
the private investment space.

[Know More][22]
[01]

## Advanced Smelting Technology

Ferrochrome is an alloy of chromium and iron containing 50-70% chromium by weight and is produced
through a carbothermic reduction process taking place at high temperatures (2,800 deg Celsius) where
chrome ore is reduced to form Ferrochrome alloy by smelting in electric arc furnaces using coke as
reducing agent. Chromite lump ore, Chrome ore Briquettes, coke, quartz are mixed in a pre-calculated
proportion. The material mix is fed into the furnaces .The ferrochrome alloy is produced via
reduction of Chromite ore to an alloy of chrome and iron.

[Know More][23]
[01]

## Sustainability

ATFA commissioned a 25MW solar power plant in collaboration with M/s Sohar Solar Qabas LLC. during
the year 2020. This being a first industrial scale solar power project which caters to the electric
power needs of the smelting plant. The new facility replaces 25% of the electrical energy consumed
from conventional to non-conventional source of electrical power (solar power). As a renewable
source of power, solar energy has an important role in reducing greenhouse gas emissions and
mitigating climate change

[Know More][24]

[
Jul 17, 2026
Can Incomplete Deoxidation in Converter Steelmaking Cause Steel Defects? Can
Silicon-Aluminum-Calcium Deoxidizer Solve This Hidden Danger?
In the converter steelmaking process, deoxidation is a critical step that determines molten steel
quality and final product performance. At the end of converter blowing, molten steel contains
excessive dissolved oxygen [O]. If deoxidation is incomplete, this oxygen reacts with carbon during
solidification, generating CO gas that compromises steel density and leads to defects such as
porosity, honeycombing, and even bulging.

Silicon Briquette
Silicon Briquette
Silicon briquettes are compacted forms of silicon metal used primarily in steelmaking and foundry
applications. These briquettes typically consist of high-purity silicon, often combined with other
alloying elements like calcium and iron. They are designed to improve the quality of steel by
enhancing its strength and resistance to corrosion. Silicon briquettes facilitate the deoxidation
process during steel production, ensuring cleaner and more efficient metal refining. Their uniform
size and composition make them easy to handle and integrate into steelmaking processes, contributing
to consistent product quality and operational efficiency in industrial settings.

Can Incomplete Deoxidation in Converter Steelmaking Cause Steel Defects? Can
Silicon-Aluminum-Calcium Deoxidizer Solve This Hidden Danger?
In the converter steelmaking process, deoxidation is a critical step that determines molten steel
quality and final product performance. At the end of converter blowing, molten steel contains
excessive dissolved oxygen [O]. If deoxidation is incomplete, this oxygen reacts with carbon during
solidification, generating CO gas that compromises steel density and leads to defects such as
porosity, honeycombing, and even bulging.

# Know More About Us

Established in 1971, BFCL has grown into a trusted symbol of excellence, reliability, and
commitment. From its origins in steel ingot production, the company has emerged as India’s largest
producer of low and medium carbon ferro manganese. With exports spanning 25+ countries, we stand
proudly among India’s top five Ferro Alloy exporters.

Our diverse product portfolio includes all grades of ferro manganese and silico manganese, with an
annual production of approximately 100,000 MT of ferro alloys, including approximately 60,000 MT of
refined ferro manganese via the CLU route.

With more than five decades of expertise, BFCL continues to modernize its operations, ensuring
consistent quality through efficient raw material sourcing and advanced processes. Our commitment to
quality and long-standing customer relationships has established BFCL as a benchmark in the ferro
alloys industry—driving sustainable growth and global recognition.

[Read More About BFCL][58]

## Our Products

[Thumbnail]

### Medium & low Carbon
### Ferro Manganese

### Medium & low Carbon
### Ferro Manganese

Our range encompasses Medium and Low Carbon Ferro Manganese in all Grades, with a manganese content
spanning 70-84%. Achieving extra low carbon content of up to 0.10% is made possible through the
advanced CLU converter.

[View Details][61]
[Thumbnail]

### High Carbon
### Ferro Manganese

### High Carbon
### Ferro Manganese

High Carbon Ferro Manganese, encompassing grades of 70-78% Mn, is produced via Submerged Electric
Arc Furnace.

[View Details][62]
[Thumbnail]

### Silico Manganese

### Silico Manganese

Our range of Silico Manganese grades, containing 60-68% Mn, is produced via a sub-merged electric
Arc Furnace. Silico Manganese enhances steel’s robustness and corrosion resistance.

[View Details][63]
[Thumbnail]

### Sponge Iron

### Sponge Iron

Processed through the direct reduction in DRI kilns, sponge iron emerges from iron and pellet ores.
This premium feedstock for steelmaking offers a cost-effective, eco-friendly alternative to
conventional extraction techniques.

[View Details][64]
[Thumbnail]

### MS Billets

### MS Billets

At BFCL, our specialization lies in producing premium-grade low-carbon MS billets. These are cast
within our steel unit equipped with an induction furnace with a Continuous Casting Machine.

[View Details][65]
[Thumbnail]

## Dr. Hari Krishna Budhia Founder and Managing Director

Founded by first-generation entrepreneur Dr. Hari Krishna Budhia, BFCL embodies over five decades of
excellence in the steel industry. After earning his Ph.D. in Chemical Engineering from the
University of Colorado, USA, in 1971, Dr. Budhia, together with his late brother Mr. A.R. Budhia,
established a steel manufacturing facility near Ranchi. Guided by his vision and leadership, BFCL
has evolved into a globally recognized name, exporting ferro alloys to more than 25 countries.

[Thumbnail]

## Mr. Gaurav Budhia Director

Under the leadership of Dr. H.K. Budhia’s successor, Mr. Gaurav Budhia, BFCL continues to thrive and
evolve. With over two decades of industry expertise, he has guided the company toward global
recognition by striking the right balance between product innovation, cost efficiency, operational
excellence, and sustainability. His unwavering commitment to higher performance standards has
propelled BFCL’s continued success. Mr. Gaurav Budhia envisions setting new industry benchmarks in
quality, customer satisfaction, and commitment—while upholding and advancing a remarkable legacy.

# Know More About Us

Established in 1971, BFCL has grown into a trusted symbol of excellence, reliability, and
commitment. From its origins in steel ingot production, the company has emerged as India’s largest
producer of low and medium carbon ferro manganese. With exports spanning 25+ countries, we stand
proudly among India’s top five Ferro Alloy exporters.

Our diverse product portfolio includes all grades of ferro manganese and silico manganese, with an
annual production of approximately 100,000 MT of ferro alloys, including approximately 60,000 MT of
refined ferro manganese via the CLU route.

With more than five decades of expertise, BFCL continues to modernize its operations, ensuring
consistent quality through efficient raw material sourcing and advanced processes. Our commitment to
quality and long-standing customer relationships has established BFCL as a benchmark in the ferro
alloys industry—driving sustainable growth and global recognition.

## Why BFCL

### Commitment

Commitment is at the core of everything we do. We prioritize client satisfaction, exceeding
expectations and building enduring relationships.

### Quality

We implement best practices throughout the manufacturing process. Stringent standards, best
practices and attention to detail ensure superior products.

### On-Time Delivery

We are boastful of our on-time delivery. Our streamlined workflow and efficient resource allocation
ensure timely deliveries without compromising quality.

### Latest Technology

ahead in the evolving steel industry.

### Competitive Pricing

to offer comparatively low prices in today’s market.

### Efficiency

Efficiency sets benchmarks for quality, punctuality and cost-effectiveness, achieved through timely
delivery, resource optimization and waste reduction.

## Our Products

[Thumbnail]

### Medium & low Carbon
### Ferro Manganese

### Medium & low Carbon
### Ferro Manganese

Our range encompasses Medium and Low Carbon Ferro Manganese in all Grades, with a manganese content
spanning 70-84%. Achieving extra low carbon content of up to 0.10% is made possible through the
advanced CLU converter.

### High Carbon

[View Details][62]

### Silico Manganese

### Silico Manganese

Our range of Silico Manganese grades, containing 60-68% Mn, is produced via a sub-merged electric
Arc Furnace. Silico Manganese enhances steel’s robustness and corrosion resistance.

[View Details][63]
[Thumbnail]

### Sponge Iron

### Sponge Iron

Processed through the direct reduction in DRI kilns, sponge iron emerges from iron and pellet ores.
This premium feedstock for steelmaking offers a cost-effective, eco-friendly alternative to
conventional extraction techniques.

[View Details][64]
[Thumbnail]

### MS Billets

### MS Billets

At BFCL, our specialization lies in producing premium-grade low-carbon MS billets. These are cast
within our steel unit equipped with an induction furnace with a Continuous Casting Machine.

[View Details][65]

## Dr. Hari Krishna Budhia Founder and Managing Director

Founded by first-generation entrepreneur Dr. Hari Krishna Budhia, BFCL embodies over five decades of
excellence in the steel industry. After earning his Ph.D. in Chemical Engineering from the
University of Colorado, USA, in 1971, Dr. Budhia, together with his late brother Mr. A.R. Budhia,
established a steel manufacturing facility near Ranchi. Guided by his vision and leadership, BFCL
has evolved into a globally recognized name, exporting ferro alloys to more than 25 countries.

[Thumbnail]

## Mr. Gaurav Budhia Director

Under the leadership of Dr. H.K. Budhia’s successor, Mr. Gaurav Budhia, BFCL continues to thrive and
evolve. With over two decades of industry expertise, he has guided the company toward global
recognition by striking the right balance between product innovation, cost efficiency, operational
excellence, and sustainability. His unwavering commitment to higher performance standards has
propelled BFCL’s continued success. Mr. Gaurav Budhia envisions setting new industry benchmarks in
quality, customer satisfaction, and commitment—while upholding and advancing a remarkable legacy.

## Light and life
## to over a billion people

BHEL contributes more than 50% of the total power generated from conventional sources

As India’s foremost power equipment manufacturer, BHEL continues to play a pivotal role in
bolstering India’s energy security

## Harnessing the
## Power of Water

With dedicated design, engineering, erection & commissioning teams, BHEL is a one-stop solution for
Hydro Power Equipment

## Powering India
## Since 1964

With 200+ GW power generating capacity installed across the world, BHEL is the undisputed leader
amongst India's Power Plant manufacturers

## BHEL - Contributing to the
## Nation's self-reliance in the
## Aerospace sector

Chandrayaan 3 is equipped with BHEL manufactured Batteries for Lander Module & Propulsion Module &
Titanium Propellent Tank

## Fueling the Aspirations
## of Emerging India

Indigenously developed & supplied sucker rod pumps for oil & gas exploration

## Serving our sentinels
## for nearly four decades

BHEL is the sole indigenous supplier of compact heat exchangers for fighter aircrafts

## BHEL - a committed Corporate
## Citizen investing in ESG

300,000+ saplings planted in last five years

Miyawaki forests in three BHEL units with cumulative coverage of 15,500+ sq.m.

## Ensuring reliable Power
## Transmission across the nation
## with state-of-the-art equipment

The first & only Transformer Manufacturer in India having successfully short circuit tested Auto
Transformers up to 500 MVA, 400 kV Class and Generator Transformer up to 333 MVA, 765 kV Class

## Nuclear Energy - Powering a
## Sustainable & Clean Future

Only company associated with all three stages of Indian Nuclear Power Programme

## Technology Innovations
## for Sustainable Development

We invest around 2.5% of our turnover in Research & Development works

## Harnessing
## Nature's Power

We are actively working on renewable energy, energy efficient systems and low emission technologies

## Equipping
## Indian Defence &
## Paramilitary Forces

Regular supplier of Super Rapid Gun Mount Naval Guns for providing Anti-Shipping and Anti-Air
capability in addition to Naval Gun Fire Support for Land Based Operations

This is an alloy of manganese, silicon, and iron. It is a cost-effective blend of manganese and
silicon and is normally the product of choice for steel manufacturers.

[Read More][8]
[High Carbon]

#### High Carbon Ferro Manganese

There are two families of Mn alloys called ferro-manganese (FeMn) and silico-manganese (SiMn).
Silico-manganese adds additional silicon which is a stronger deoxidizer and which also helps to
improve some mechanical properties of steel.

[Read More][9]
[Lead]

#### Lead

Lead is used in building construction, lead-acid accumulators, bullets and shot, and is part of
solder, pewter, and fusible alloys.

## We Provide Solutions For the materials industry

[View More Solution ][102]
We are delighted to announce that we have passed an in-depth set of assessments to achieve the ISO
9001:2015 certification for our quality management systems.
01
[ [Ceramic Industry] ][103]

## [Ceramic Industry][104]

Enhance your ceramic products with our specialized range of high-purity functional materials. These
carefully selected oxides deliver exceptional properties for various ceramic applications, from
vibrant coloration to improved technical performance.   Cerium Oxide (CeO₂) acts as an effective
opacifier and stabilizer in ceramic glazes, while Lanthanum Oxide (La₂O₃) enhances thermal stability
and density in technical ceramics. For rich blue hues, Cobalt Oxide (Co₃O₄) provides intense and
stable coloration in both glazes and ceramic bodies. Vanadium Pentoxide (V₂O₅) serves as a brilliant
yellow pigment and flux modifier. Bismuth Trioxide (Bi₂O₃) enables the production of lead-free
glazes with excellent surface quality, and Molybdenum Trioxide (MoO₃) contributes to unique color
effects and improved adherence in specialized coatings.   We supply these materials in various
purity grades and particle sizes to meet your specific manufacturing requirements. Our technical
team is ready to help you select the optimal materials for your ceramic applications. Contact us
today to discuss how our products can enhance your ceramic formulations.

02
[ [Optical Glass] ][105]

## [Optical Glass][106]

We supply high-purity materials specifically engineered for optical glass manufacturing, enabling
superior performance across various applications. Our Lanthanum Oxide (La₂O₃) significantly
increases refractive index, essential for high-quality camera lenses and precision optics. Cerium
Oxide (CeO₂) serves dual purposes as both an effective polishing compound and UV-absorbing agent,
protecting glass from solar radiation. Arsenic Trioxide (As₂O₃) acts as a refining agent to
eliminate bubbles and enhance clarity, while Rubidium Oxide (Rb₂O) modifies optical properties for
specialized applications. Tin Oxide (SnO₂) provides durable, transparent conductive coatings for
smart glass and display technologies.   These materials are available in customized purity levels
and particle size distributions to meet specific manufacturing requirements. With stringent quality
control and reliable global supply chain management, we ensure consistent performance batch after
batch. Our technical team offers comprehensive support to help optimize your formulations and
processes.   Trust our expertise to enhance your optical glass products with materials that deliver
exceptional clarity, durability, and functionality. Contact us to discuss how our specialized
products can advance your optical applications.

03
[ [Electronic Industry] ][107]

## [Electronic Industry][108]

Our comprehensive portfolio of high-purity electronic materials powers innovation across the
electronics industry. We supply essential elements including Lithium compounds for lithium-ion
batteries and energy storage systems, Cobalt and Nickel salts for battery cathode materials,
and Bismuth alloys for environmentally friendly, lead-free electronics and low-melting point
solders. Our Molybdenum products serve critical roles in thin-film transistors, display
technologies, and semiconductor applications. These materials are manufactured to the highest purity
standards, ensuring optimal performance in batteries, semiconductors, displays, and advanced
electronic components. With rigorous quality control and reliable supply chain management, we
support our clients in developing smaller, faster, and more efficient electronic devices. Our
technical team provides expert guidance to help you select the right materials for your specific
applications. Contact us to discuss how our electronic materials can enhance your products and drive
your technological innovations forward.

04
[ [Metallurgy Industry] ][109]

## [Metallurgy Industry][110]

We supply high-performance metals and alloys critical for modern metallurgical applications. Our
portfolio includes rare earth metals like Lanthanum and Cerium, which serve as powerful alloying
additives and desulfurization agents in steel and aluminum production, enhancing material strength
and workability. We also provide high-purity Magnesium ingots for lightweight alloy manufacturing,
Germanium metal for specialized semiconductor and infrared applications, and Tin products for
soldering, coating, and bronze alloys. These materials are processed to meet strict industry
standards, ensuring consistent quality and reliable performance in your production processes. From
improving mechanical properties to enabling specialized functionalities, our products support
innovation across automotive, aerospace, electronics, and general metalworking sectors. Our
technical team understands metallurgical processes and can recommend the most suitable materials for
your specific requirements. Trust us to be your reliable partner for quality metallurgical materials
that drive industrial advancement. Contact us to discuss how our products can enhance your
manufacturing outcomes.

05
[ [Oil Industry] ][111]

## [Oil Industry][112]

We supply high-performance chemical materials critical for modern petrochemical processes. Our Zinc
Oxide serves as a robust desulfurization agent and catalyst component, effectively removing
impurities from hydrocarbon streams. Magnesium Oxide acts as an effective adsorbent and neutralizing
agent in refining operations, handling acidic compounds with high efficiency. Vanadium Pentoxide is
indispensable as a primary catalyst for sulfuric acid production and oxidative desulfurization,
demonstrating exceptional catalytic activity. Manganese Tetroxide functions as a versatile catalyst
in oxidation reactions and emission control systems. These high-purity materials undergo rigorous
quality control to ensure consistent performance in demanding refinery environments. From catalytic
cracking to pollution control and product purification, our products deliver reliable results across
various petrochemical applications. Our technical team possesses deep industry knowledge and can
provide expert guidance on material selection and optimization for your specific processes. Trust
our proven products to enhance your operational efficiency, product quality, and environmental
compliance. Contact us to discover how our specialized materials can support your petrochemical
operations and drive your business forward.

[ [Ceramic Industry] ][103]

## [Ceramic Industry][104]

Enhance your ceramic products with our specialized range of high-purity functional materials. These
carefully selected oxides deliver exceptional properties for various ceramic applications, from
vibrant coloration to improved technical performance.   Cerium Oxide (CeO₂) acts as an effective
opacifier and stabilizer in ceramic glazes, while Lanthanum Oxide (La₂O₃) enhances thermal stability
and density in technical ceramics. For rich blue hues, Cobalt Oxide (Co₃O₄) provides intense and
stable coloration in both glazes and ceramic bodies. Vanadium Pentoxide (V₂O₅) serves as a brilliant
yellow pigment and flux modifier. Bismuth Trioxide (Bi₂O₃) enables the production of lead-free
glazes with excellent surface quality, and Molybdenum Trioxide (MoO₃) contributes to unique color
effects and improved adherence in specialized coatings.   We supply these materials in various
purity grades and particle sizes to meet your specific manufacturing requirements. Our technical
team is ready to help you select the optimal materials for your ceramic applications. Contact us
today to discuss how our products can enhance your ceramic formulations.

02
[ [Optical Glass] ][105]

## [Optical Glass][106]

We supply high-purity materials specifically engineered for optical glass manufacturing, enabling
superior performance across various applications. Our Lanthanum Oxide (La₂O₃) significantly
increases refractive index, essential for high-quality camera lenses and precision optics. Cerium
Oxide (CeO₂) serves dual purposes as both an effective polishing compound and UV-absorbing agent,
protecting glass from solar radiation. Arsenic Trioxide (As₂O₃) acts as a refining agent to
eliminate bubbles and enhance clarity, while Rubidium Oxide (Rb₂O) modifies optical properties for
specialized applications. Tin Oxide (SnO₂) provides durable, transparent conductive coatings for
smart glass and display technologies.   These materials are available in customized purity levels
and particle size distributions to meet specific manufacturing requirements. With stringent quality
control and reliable global supply chain management, we ensure consistent performance batch after
batch. Our technical team offers comprehensive support to help optimize your formulations and
processes.   Trust our expertise to enhance your optical glass products with materials that deliver
exceptional clarity, durability, and functionality. Contact us to discuss how our specialized
products can advance your optical applications.

03
[ [Electronic Industry] ][107]

## [Electronic Industry][108]

Our comprehensive portfolio of high-purity electronic materials powers innovation across the
electronics industry. We supply essential elements including Lithium compounds for lithium-ion
batteries and energy storage systems, Cobalt and Nickel salts for battery cathode materials,
and Bismuth alloys for environmentally friendly, lead-free electronics and low-melting point
solders. Our Molybdenum products serve critical roles in thin-film transistors, display
technologies, and semiconductor applications. These materials are manufactured to the highest purity
standards, ensuring optimal performance in batteries, semiconductors, displays, and advanced
electronic components. With rigorous quality control and reliable supply chain management, we
support our clients in developing smaller, faster, and more efficient electronic devices. Our
technical team provides expert guidance to help you select the right materials for your specific
applications. Contact us to discuss how our electronic materials can enhance your products and drive
your technological innovations forward.

04
[ [Metallurgy Industry] ][109]

## [Metallurgy Industry][110]

We supply high-performance metals and alloys critical for modern metallurgical applications. Our
portfolio includes rare earth metals like Lanthanum and Cerium, which serve as powerful alloying
additives and desulfurization agents in steel and aluminum production, enhancing material strength
and workability. We also provide high-purity Magnesium ingots for lightweight alloy manufacturing,
Germanium metal for specialized semiconductor and infrared applications, and Tin products for
soldering, coating, and bronze alloys. These materials are processed to meet strict industry
standards, ensuring consistent quality and reliable performance in your production processes. From
improving mechanical properties to enabling specialized functionalities, our products support
innovation across automotive, aerospace, electronics, and general metalworking sectors. Our
technical team understands metallurgical processes and can recommend the most suitable materials for
your specific requirements. Trust us to be your reliable partner for quality metallurgical materials
that drive industrial advancement. Contact us to discuss how our products can enhance your
manufacturing outcomes.

05
[ [Oil Industry] ][111]

## [Oil Industry][112]

We supply high-performance chemical materials critical for modern petrochemical processes. Our Zinc
Oxide serves as a robust desulfurization agent and catalyst component, effectively removing
impurities from hydrocarbon streams. Magnesium Oxide acts as an effective adsorbent and neutralizing
agent in refining operations, handling acidic compounds with high efficiency. Vanadium Pentoxide is
indispensable as a primary catalyst for sulfuric acid production and oxidative desulfurization,
demonstrating exceptional catalytic activity. Manganese Tetroxide functions as a versatile catalyst
in oxidation reactions and emission control systems. These high-purity materials undergo rigorous
quality control to ensure consistent performance in demanding refinery environments. From catalytic
cracking to pollution control and product purification, our products deliver reliable results across
various petrochemical applications. Our technical team possesses deep industry knowledge and can
provide expert guidance on material selection and optimization for your specific processes. Trust
our proven products to enhance your operational efficiency, product quality, and environmental
compliance. Contact us to discover how our specialized materials can support your petrochemical
operations and drive your business forward.

## Frequently asked questions

[ How do you manufacture ferro alloys? ][37]

At Hira Ferro Alloys Ltd, we manufacture ferro alloys through a rigorous process. We start by
sourcing high-quality raw materials, such as manganese ores and chromite ores, mainly from within
Chhattisgarh, India. These raw materials are then smelted in our state-of-the-art electric arc
furnaces, using advanced technology and equipment.

[Who produces ferro alloys in the world?][38]

Ferro alloys are produced by various companies and countries worldwide. However, at Hira Ferro
Alloys Ltd, we take pride in being one of the leading producers of ferro alloys in India. With our
advanced technology, extensive industry experience, and dedicated team, we consistently strive to
maintain high standards of production and contribute to the global ferro alloys market.

[Who is the biggest exporter of ferroalloys?][39]

While we excel in exporting ferro alloys, at Hira Ferro Alloys Ltd, we focus on producing
high-quality products for the domestic and international markets both. Our main focus is exporting
green ferro alloys, we ensure that our ferro alloys meet international standards of carbon footprint
and can be supplied globally.

[ Who is the producer of ferro alloys in India? ][40]

Hira Ferro Alloys Ltd is a prominent producer of ferro alloys in India. With our manufacturing
facilities located in Chhattisgarh, we have established ourselves as a reliable supplier of ferro
alloys in the country. Our commitment to quality, customer satisfaction, and continuous innovation
has made us a preferred choice for various industries that require ferro alloys.

[ What are the raw materials for ferro alloys? ][41]

The raw materials used for manufacturing ferro alloys include manganese ores, and certain other
additives. At Hira Ferro Alloys Ltd, we primarily source these raw materials from within
Chhattisgarh, India, to ensure their quality and availability.

[ Who are the importers of ferro alloys? ][42]

Importers of ferro alloys include various countries and industries that require these products for
their manufacturing processes. Some prominent importers of ferro alloys who import from Hira ferro
alloys are countries such as the United States, Germany, Japan, and the United Kingdom.

[ Where is the richest manganese deposit in India? ][43]

India is blessed with abundant manganese deposits, with one of the richest deposits located in
Chhattisgarh. Our state is known for its vast manganese reserves, contributing significantly to the
ferro alloys industry in India. The Balaghat district in Madhya Pradesh and other nearby states like
Jharkhand, Odisha, and Karnataka also have notable deposits of manganese. Our strategic location in
Chhattisgarh provides us with easy access to these rich deposits, allowing us to source high-quality
manganese ores for our ferro alloy production.

## Frequently asked questions

[ How do you manufacture ferro alloys? ][37]

At Hira Ferro Alloys Ltd, we manufacture ferro alloys through a rigorous process. We start by
sourcing high-quality raw materials, such as manganese ores and chromite ores, mainly from within
Chhattisgarh, India. These raw materials are then smelted in our state-of-the-art electric arc
furnaces, using advanced technology and equipment.

[Who produces ferro alloys in the world?][38]

Ferro alloys are produced by various companies and countries worldwide. However, at Hira Ferro
Alloys Ltd, we take pride in being one of the leading producers of ferro alloys in India. With our
advanced technology, extensive industry experience, and dedicated team, we consistently strive to
maintain high standards of production and contribute to the global ferro alloys market.

[Who is the biggest exporter of ferroalloys?][39]

While we excel in exporting ferro alloys, at Hira Ferro Alloys Ltd, we focus on producing
high-quality products for the domestic and international markets both. Our main focus is exporting
green ferro alloys, we ensure that our ferro alloys meet international standards of carbon footprint
and can be supplied globally.

[ Who is the producer of ferro alloys in India? ][40]

Hira Ferro Alloys Ltd is a prominent producer of ferro alloys in India. With our manufacturing
facilities located in Chhattisgarh, we have established ourselves as a reliable supplier of ferro
alloys in the country. Our commitment to quality, customer satisfaction, and continuous innovation
has made us a preferred choice for various industries that require ferro alloys.

[ What are the raw materials for ferro alloys? ][41]

The raw materials used for manufacturing ferro alloys include manganese ores, and certain other
additives. At Hira Ferro Alloys Ltd, we primarily source these raw materials from within
Chhattisgarh, India, to ensure their quality and availability.

[ Who are the importers of ferro alloys? ][42]

Importers of ferro alloys include various countries and industries that require these products for
their manufacturing processes. Some prominent importers of ferro alloys who import from Hira ferro
alloys are countries such as the United States, Germany, Japan, and the United Kingdom.

[ Where is the richest manganese deposit in India? ][43]

India is blessed with abundant manganese deposits, with one of the richest deposits located in
Chhattisgarh. Our state is known for its vast manganese reserves, contributing significantly to the
ferro alloys industry in India. The Balaghat district in Madhya Pradesh and other nearby states like
Jharkhand, Odisha, and Karnataka also have notable deposits of manganese. Our strategic location in
Chhattisgarh provides us with easy access to these rich deposits, allowing us to source high-quality
manganese ores for our ferro alloy production.

# Lot Date Cosmetic Batch Code Checker

Lot Date helps you check cosmetic batch codes, lot codes, and lot numbers to estimate production
date, expiry context, and freshness before buying, opening, or rotating skincare, makeup, and
fragrance.

[Browse brand directories][8][Read batch code guides][9][Download App (AI engine, stronger checks,

directory.

## FAQ

#### How do I check a cosmetic batch code or lot number?

Choose the brand first, then enter the short printed batch code or lot number exactly as shown,
including letters, leading zeroes, and separators. Do not use the barcode, shade number, product
reference, or store label.

#### Is a cosmetic lot code the same as a batch code or lot number?

Usually. Cosmetic brands and shoppers may use lot code, lot number, batch code, or batch number for
the production-lot identifier. The wording varies by brand, so use the short code printed on the
package rather than the barcode.

#### Why does the result sometimes show only year and month?

Some cosmetic brands do not encode an exact day in the batch code, so month-level output is normal.
In that case, use the result together with the PAO symbol, your purchase date, and the current
condition of the product.

#### What if the decoded date does not match when or where I bought the product?

That usually means the code system is cyclical or the product sat in stock for a while before sale.
Compare the result with packaging generation, retailer turnover, and seller information, then treat
official label guidance as the final reference.

#### Where can I find a cosmetic batch code quickly?

Check the box bottom first, then the bottle base, cap edge, crimp area, or outer seal. The correct
lot code is usually a short alphanumeric string, not the barcode, shade number, or a long regulatory
label code.

#### Can I use the decoded date to decide what to open or finish first?

Yes. Sort similar products by likely production timing, open the older ones first, and avoid adding
backups when you already have near-edge stock. This works best when you also record the month each
product was opened.

#### Does a decoded date prove a cosmetic product is safe or authentic?

No. Batch-code decoding is a freshness signal, not proof of safety or authenticity. You still need
to check seller reliability, packaging quality, PAO guidance, storage history, and any changes in
smell, color, or texture.

## How to Find Cosmetic Batch Codes and Lot Numbers on Packaging

The fastest way to get a reliable production-date estimate is to copy the exact batch code from the
package. Most failed lookups happen before decoding starts: the wrong string is used, one character
is missing, or a barcode, SKU, or shade code gets entered instead of the real lot number.
* Check the box first, then confirm the bottle or jar.
* Copy the code exactly, including letters, zeroes, and separators.
* Ignore nearby SKU, shade, or barcode numbers that are not the batch code.

### Where batch codes usually appear

Cosmetic batch codes are often stamped on the box bottom, bottle base, crimp area, cap edge, or
outer seal. Fragrance bottles often hide the code on the glass base, while skincare jars may place
it near the bottom sticker.
* Box bottom or side flap
* Bottle or jar base
* Tube crimp or shoulder

### What counts as a batch code

A batch code is usually shorter than a barcode and may combine letters and numbers. It is not the
EAN/UPC barcode, not the product shade name, and not a long compliance code block.
* Look for short stamped or ink-jetted strings.
* Keep leading zeroes and letter case when entering the code.
* Do not merge two nearby strings into one input.

## FAQ

#### How do I check a cosmetic batch code or lot number?

Choose the brand first, then enter the short printed batch code or lot number exactly as shown,
including letters, leading zeroes, and separators. Do not use the barcode, shade number, product
reference, or store label.

#### Is a cosmetic lot code the same as a batch code or lot number?

Usually. Cosmetic brands and shoppers may use lot code, lot number, batch code, or batch number for
the production-lot identifier. The wording varies by brand, so use the short code printed on the
package rather than the barcode.

#### Why does the result sometimes show only year and month?

Some cosmetic brands do not encode an exact day in the batch code, so month-level output is normal.
In that case, use the result together with the PAO symbol, your purchase date, and the current
condition of the product.

#### What if the decoded date does not match when or where I bought the product?

That usually means the code system is cyclical or the product sat in stock for a while before sale.
Compare the result with packaging generation, retailer turnover, and seller information, then treat
official label guidance as the final reference.

#### Where can I find a cosmetic batch code quickly?

Check the box bottom first, then the bottle base, cap edge, crimp area, or outer seal. The correct
lot code is usually a short alphanumeric string, not the barcode, shade number, or a long regulatory
label code.

#### Can I use the decoded date to decide what to open or finish first?

Yes. Sort similar products by likely production timing, open the older ones first, and avoid adding
backups when you already have near-edge stock. This works best when you also record the month each
product was opened.

#### Does a decoded date prove a cosmetic product is safe or authentic?

No. Batch-code decoding is a freshness signal, not proof of safety or authenticity. You still need
to check seller reliability, packaging quality, PAO guidance, storage history, and any changes in
smell, color, or texture.

## How to Find Cosmetic Batch Codes and Lot Numbers on Packaging

The fastest way to get a reliable production-date estimate is to copy the exact batch code from the
package. Most failed lookups happen before decoding starts: the wrong string is used, one character
is missing, or a barcode, SKU, or shade code gets entered instead of the real lot number.
* Check the box first, then confirm the bottle or jar.
* Copy the code exactly, including letters, zeroes, and separators.
* Ignore nearby SKU, shade, or barcode numbers that are not the batch code.

### Where batch codes usually appear

Cosmetic batch codes are often stamped on the box bottom, bottle base, crimp area, cap edge, or
outer seal. Fragrance bottles often hide the code on the glass base, while skincare jars may place
it near the bottom sticker.
* Box bottom or side flap
* Bottle or jar base
* Tube crimp or shoulder

### What counts as a batch code

A batch code is usually shorter than a barcode and may combine letters and numbers. It is not the
EAN/UPC barcode, not the product shade name, and not a long compliance code block.
* Look for short stamped or ink-jetted strings.
* Keep leading zeroes and letter case when entering the code.
* Do not merge two nearby strings into one input.

## Who We Are

Founded in 1978, the Mortex Group specializes in production & exports of Bulk Ferro Alloys, keeping
the focus on Manganese, Chrome and Si based alloys.

Committed to growing and expanding in ways that support customers’ needs, we have successfully
established ourselves as a major name in the field of Ferro Alloys, with a market presence in 6 of
the 7 continents of the world.

We aim at customer satisfaction by meeting our customers’ needs with precisely the right solutions
by efficiently understanding intricate and diverse customer needs. We meet these challenges by
extending high-quality products, competitive pricing, on-time shipment, ensuring maximum commitment
and dedication from our side.

## Our Products

## Silico Manganese

Widely used in the steel manufacturing process as an allowing agent, Silico Manganese offers the
necessary hardness and toughness and therefore, is an integral element of the steel making process

[ EXPLORE ][46]

## Ferro Manganese

Used in producing steel as well as foundry products, Ferro Manganese imparts metallurgical
characteristics like increased strength, toughness and hardness to the final product

[ EXPLORE ][47]

## Ferro Chrome

As a main ingredient used for producing stainless steel, Ferro Chrome delivers shinning appearance
and corrosion resistance. It is also used in the metallurgical industry, chemical industry and
refractory & foundry industry

[ EXPLORE ][48]

## Ferro Silicon

Used as a silicon source, Ferro Silicon aids in deoxidizing steel and other alloys so that carbon
loss can be prevented from the molten steel. It is also used for prealloy and cast iron
manufacturing

#### Bankable Project Reports & Feasibility Study Services

Get professionally crafted, bankable project reports tailored to your business needs. Each report
includes detailed market analysis, techno-economic feasibility, manufacturing process, machinery
planning, investment estimates, and regulatory insights which is ideal for start-ups, entrepreneurs,
and expanding industries. Our DPRs (Detailed Project Reports) are research-driven,
implementation-ready, and suitable for bank loans, investor approvals, and business planning.
Make confident decisions with accurate, practical, and industry-focused documentation designed to
support successful project execution.

[Learn More ][81]
[Project Reports Illustration]

#### While expanding a current business or while venturing into new business, entrepreneurs are
#### often faced with the dilemma of zeroing in on a suitable product/line.

The report provides an expansive market analysis by covering areas like: growth drivers, trends
prevailing in the industry, Demand-Supply Situation, Foreign Trade, Porters 5 Forces Analysis,
regulatory framework as well as comprehensive SWOT analysis of the sector.

The report further establishes the regulatory framework of the industry. It encapsulates the status
of the current legislation in the industry as well as the recent changes and developments in the
regulations. The report also provides key player profiles along with key financials and comparison.
The market research report shares vital information like shareholding pattern, revenue mix, plant
location and financial summary of the key companies.

[Learn More ][82]
[Market Research Illustration]

#### Industrial Development Technologies & Project Opportunities

Entrepreneur India,  a monthly magazine published by Niir Project Consultancy Services (NPCS) is
aimed at simplifying the process of choosing the suitable project for investment. It makes business
decisions easier and trouble-free by providing a list of right projects for investment. Unique among
project investment magazines, 'Entrepreneur India' is dedicated to the business of identifying sound
investment projects. Every issue consists of a new list of projects which are meticulously selected
by the Niir Project Consultancy Services (NPCS) team after being screened on various investment
factors. Niir Project Consultancy Services (NPCS) team, before labeling a project as 'Right
investment' studies various aspects of investment like product demand, market potential, raw
material availability, suitable location, payback period, costs involved and breakeven point.

[Learn More ][83]
[Entrepreneur India Illustration]

#### Select and Choose the Right Business Startup for You

(Instant Online Project Identification and Selection)

(Instant Online Project Identification and Selection)

Finding the right startup business is one of the most popular subject today. Starting a business is
no easy endeavour, but the time, effort, and challenges can be worth it if you succeed. To give
yourself the best chance to be successful, take your time to carefully find the right business for
you.

We, at Niir Project Consultancy Services (NPCS), endeavour to make business selection a simple and
convenient step for any entrepreneur/startup. Our expert team, by capitalizing on its dexterity and
decade's long experience in the field, has created a list of profitable ventures for entrepreneurs
who wish to diversify or venture. The list so mentioned is updated regularly to give you a regular
dose of new emerging opportunities.

[Learn More ][84]
[Startup Selector Illustration]

## What We Offer

We help our clients meet challenges and seize opportunities successfully by providing a
comprehensive suite of expert services.

[Beginning]

#### Beginning

Project Introduction, Brief History of the Product, Properties, BIS (Bureau of Indian Standard)
Specifications & Requirements, Uses & Applications.

[Manufacturing Techniques]

#### Manufacturing Techniques

Formulae Detailed Process of Manufacture, Flow Sheet Diagram.

[Market Survey]

#### Market Survey

Present Market Position, Expected Future Demand, Statistics of Imports & Exports, Export Prospect,
Names and Addresses of Existing Units (Present Manufactures).

[Personnel Requirement]

#### Personnel Requirement

Requirement of Staff & Labour, Personnel Management, Skilled & Unskilled Labour.

[Plant & Machinery]

#### Plant & Machinery

List of Plant & Machineries, Miscellaneous Items and Accessories, Instruments, Laboratory
Equipment's and Accessories, Plant Location, Electrification, Electric Load and Water, Maintenance,
Suppliers / Manufacturers of Plant and Machineries.

[Land & Building]

#### Land & Building

Requirement of Land Area, Rates of the Land, Built up Area, Construction Schedule, Plant Layout.

[Raw Material]

#### Raw Material

List of Raw Materials, Properties of Raw Materials, Availability of Raw Materials, Required Quality
of Raw Materials, Cost / Rates of Raw Materials.

[Financial Aspects]

#### Financial Aspects

Cost of Raw Materials, Cost of Land & Building, Cost of Plant & Machineries, Fixed Capital
Investment, Working Capital, Project Cost, Capital Formation, Cost of Production, Profitability
Analysis, Break Even Point, Cash Flow Statement for 5 to 10 Years, Depreciation Chart, Conclusion,
Projected Balance Sheet, Land Man Ratio.

[Entrepreneur India (An Industrial Monthly Journal)]

#### Entrepreneur India (An Industrial Monthly Journal)

Entrepreneur India is a monthly industrial magazine focused on development, technologies, and
project opportunities. It simplifies investment decisions for business leaders, young entrepreneurs,
women entrepreneurs, investors, NRIs, startups, and professionals, providing crucial information on
viable projects. It's the ideal resource for identifying sound investment opportunities.

  The majority of our business happens with the offshore clients. For this purpose, we have got into

  reliable vendors and ensure credible procurement methods. We only import the products that are

  records and financial status of the clients. Moreover, to exceed our client’s expectation, we
  maintain a good association with all our vendors.
* [Manufacturing Unit]
  Manufacturing Unit
  
  We introduce ourselves as manufacturers, importers, and agents of raw materials required by Steel
  Plants and Foundries with a group turnover of approximately Rupees 850 Crores. Our company markets
  Pig Iron and Sponge Iron of M/S Jayaswals NECO Industries Ltd, M/S Kirloskar Ferrous Industries
  Ltd. and M/S Sunflag Iron & Steels Ltd. who are major producers of Pig Iron in India. We have a
  manufacturing unit in Chandrapur for Minerals Pulverizing, Coal Dust, Lustrous Carbon Powder,
  Inoculants, Graphite and Nodulizer that are widely demanded by foundries.
* [Distribution Network]
  Distribution Network
  
  Being a giant company, having manufacturing units across the length and breath of the country, we
  have wide, effective and efficient network that ensures timely delivery of our world class
  products to any nook and corner of the world. In past two decades of our existence, we have
  developed extensive network of qualified & experienced traders, merchants and dealers from
  different countries like China, South Africa, Russia, Nepal, Bhutan, India and European Countries,
  who undertake marketing of the products.

طیف وسیعی از صنایع از جمله آهن، آلومینیوم و سایر صنایع فلزی و شیمیایی تخصص دارد. تیم ما به ارائه
خدمات تجارت جهانی استثنایی برای مشتریان خود شهرت دارد. ما چالش‌های پیچیده‌ای را که با تجارت بین‌المللی
پیش می‌آید درک می‌کنیم و تیمی از متخصصان با تجربه در سراسر جهان را گرد هم آورده‌ایم که متعهد به ارائه
بهترین نتیجه هستند. ما به ایجاد شراکت قوی با مشتریان خود و همکاری نزدیک با آنها برای درک و رفع
نیازها و خواسته هایشان اعتقاد داریم.

خدمات تجارت جهانی استثنایی برای مشتریان خود شهرت دارد. ما چالش‌های پیچیده‌ای را که با تجارت بین‌المللی
پیش می‌آید درک می‌کنیم و تیمی از متخصصان با تجربه در سراسر جهان را گرد هم آورده‌ایم که متعهد به ارائه
بهترین نتیجه هستند. ما به ایجاد شراکت قوی با مشتریان خود و همکاری نزدیک با آنها برای درک و رفع
نیازها و خواسته هایشان اعتقاد داریم.

در تراملت، ما فقط یک شرکت تجاری نیستیم، بلکه همراهان ثابت قدم شما در عرصه تجارت جهانی هستیم. در
پیچیدگی‌های تجارت بین‌المللی، ما همچون نوری پایدار از حس اطمینان ایستاده‌ایم و متعهد به ارائه خدمات
تجاری فوق العاده ای که فراتر از مرزها و انتظاراتند، هستیم.

ما می دانیم که دنیای تجارت بین المللی پیچیده و سخت است به همین دلیل است که تیم متخصصان با تجربه ما
که به صورت استراتژیک در سرتاسر جهان مستقر هستند، برای ارائه بالاترین کیفیت و ارزش ها بدون هیچ لغزش و
ترسی آماده اند. با تعهد جمعی ما به تعالی و برتری، آماده غلبه بر هر مانعی هستیم که تجارت بین‌المللی
ممکن است ایجاد ‌کند.

# T W Logistics Ltd

### Established over 50 years ago, TWL specialises in the handling and processing of industrial raw
### materials and feedstock for national and international commodity traders and manufacturers.

Whilst historically focusing on ferro alloys in the North and agri-products in the South of the UK,
the company has expanded and diversified in response to market needs and today handles a wide range
of bulk and packed products, offering a full range of cargo handling, logistics and toll processing
services.

## Ports and Logistics

Operating from four well placed sites in the UK, we provide customers with an efficient logistical
solution.

Cargoes for the Midlands and the North of the UK can be handled at our Gainsborough and Scunthorpe
facilities, with goods imported through dedicated River Trent berths or arriving in containers or
road trailers through the main UK deepwater ports and container terminals.

Cargoes for the Midlands, South and East of the UK can be handled directly at the Port of Mistley in
Essex in coaster sized vessels, or received by container or road trailer through the major Southern
container terminals at Felixstowe, Tilbury and London.

## Materials Processing

The TWL Group continues to make substantial investments in processing equipment and specialises in
the conversion of bulk raw materials and feedstocks into required formats for national and
international manufacturers.

Our staff are highly experienced and are here to help you, and we pride ourselves in continually
exploring ways to adapt and invest in new processes in order to support our customers and their
constantly changing markets.

## Specialist Services - Bespoke Solutions

In addition to our comprehensive range of toll processing, we also provide bespoke processing
solutions for specific projects. We work closely with universities and research institutions in
order to provide bespoke, efficient and cost effective solutions for our clients in the fast moving
field of materials technology.

# T W Logistics Ltd

### Established over 50 years ago, TWL specialises in the handling and processing of industrial raw
### materials and feedstock for national and international commodity traders and manufacturers.

Whilst historically focusing on ferro alloys in the North and agri-products in the South of the UK,
the company has expanded and diversified in response to market needs and today handles a wide range
of bulk and packed products, offering a full range of cargo handling, logistics and toll processing
services.

## Ports and Logistics

Operating from four well placed sites in the UK, we provide customers with an efficient logistical
solution.

Cargoes for the Midlands and the North of the UK can be handled at our Gainsborough and Scunthorpe
facilities, with goods imported through dedicated River Trent berths or arriving in containers or
road trailers through the main UK deepwater ports and container terminals.

Cargoes for the Midlands, South and East of the UK can be handled directly at the Port of Mistley in
Essex in coaster sized vessels, or received by container or road trailer through the major Southern
container terminals at Felixstowe, Tilbury and London.

## Materials Processing

The TWL Group continues to make substantial investments in processing equipment and specialises in
the conversion of bulk raw materials and feedstocks into required formats for national and
international manufacturers.

Our staff are highly experienced and are here to help you, and we pride ourselves in continually
exploring ways to adapt and invest in new processes in order to support our customers and their
constantly changing markets.

## Specialist Services - Bespoke Solutions

In addition to our comprehensive range of toll processing, we also provide bespoke processing
solutions for specific projects. We work closely with universities and research institutions in
order to provide bespoke, efficient and cost effective solutions for our clients in the fast moving
field of materials technology.

About Us
Uma Enterprise is a trusted name in the field of industrial raw materials, specializing in the
trading and supply of high-grade ferro alloys. With a strong commitment to quality, consistency, and
customer satisfaction, we have positioned ourselves as a dependable partner for businesses across
the metallurgical and manufacturing sectors. Our expertise lies in sourcing and delivering premium
materials that meet stringent industry requirements.

We offer a comprehensive range of ferro alloys including High Carbon Ferro Manganese, High Carbon
Ferro Chrome, Ferro Phosphorus, Ferro Silicon, and Ferro Vanadium. These materials are essential in
steelmaking and various metallurgical processes, where precision and purity directly impact the
final output. Our products are procured from reliable sources and are carefully evaluated to ensure
they meet required chemical compositions and performance standards.

**Commitment to Quality**

Quality is the foundation of our operations. At Uma Enterprise, we follow strict quality control
measures to ensure that every batch supplied aligns with industry specifications. Our focus on
consistency helps our clients maintain efficiency and reliability in their production processes. We
believe that delivering the right quality at the right time builds long-term trust and credibility.

**Customer-Centric Approach**

Understanding the dynamic needs of our clients is central to our business philosophy. We work
closely with customers to provide tailored solutions that match their specific requirements. Whether
it is bulk supply, urgent delivery, or customized material specifications, our team ensures a
seamless and responsive service experience.

About Us
Uma Enterprise is a trusted name in the field of industrial raw materials, specializing in the
trading and supply of high-grade ferro alloys. With a strong commitment to quality, consistency, and
customer satisfaction, we have positioned ourselves as a dependable partner for businesses across
the metallurgical and manufacturing sectors. Our expertise lies in sourcing and delivering premium
materials that meet stringent industry requirements.

We offer a comprehensive range of ferro alloys including High Carbon Ferro Manganese, High Carbon
Ferro Chrome, Ferro Phosphorus, Ferro Silicon, and Ferro Vanadium. These materials are essential in
steelmaking and various metallurgical processes, where precision and purity directly impact the
final output. Our products are procured from reliable sources and are carefully evaluated to ensure
they meet required chemical compositions and performance standards.

**Commitment to Quality**

Quality is the foundation of our operations. At Uma Enterprise, we follow strict quality control
measures to ensure that every batch supplied aligns with industry specifications. Our focus on
consistency helps our clients maintain efficiency and reliability in their production processes. We
believe that delivering the right quality at the right time builds long-term trust and credibility.

**Customer-Centric Approach**

Understanding the dynamic needs of our clients is central to our business philosophy. We work
closely with customers to provide tailored solutions that match their specific requirements. Whether
it is bulk supply, urgent delivery, or customized material specifications, our team ensures a
seamless and responsive service experience.

operations. It specializes in metallurgical and refractory materials.

produces and sells more than 1.5 million tonnes of goods annually, and is equipped with all the

other items.
